title: voice.state
description: Voice pipeline state broadcast over SSE and ingested via REST relay

transcript.description: Recognized user utterance returned by STT; null when idle or before transcription completes

reply.description: Assistant reply text returned by the agent brain; rendered as caption toasts

tts_engine.description: Name of the active TTS engine synthesizing or speaking audio (e.g. kokoro, elevenlabs, piper)

status.description: Active intermediate tool execution or thinking status badge streamed from agent brain
